blocks.text:
## What to expect on your trip

Peru preserves traces of several ancient civilisations. This itinerary begins in Lima, then climbs into the Andes to Cusco and Machu Picchu, visits Inca archaeological sites and continues to the high-altitude Lake Titicaca.

You will see Cusco, the ancient Inca capital, Machu Picchu hidden among the mountains, the floating Uros islands and colonial Lima. Optional excursions let you extend the itinerary to the Sacred Valley, the Paracas coast and the Nazca desert.
